onboarding.language_description: Select the language you'd like to use BrainGuin in. Don't worry, you can always change this later in your settings!
onboarding.welcome_description: Stop wasting hours highlighting textbooks and rewriting notes. BrainGuin uses AI to do the heavy lifting, turning any study material into bite-sized knowledge you will actually remember.
onboarding.creation_description: Got a massive PDF? A long web article? Or just a specific topic? Feed it to BrainGuin. Our AI instantly digests your material and extracts the absolute most important facts for you.
onboarding.science_description: We use a science-backed Spaced Repetition algorithm that predicts exactly when you are about to forget a fact and brings it back to you. Got a deadline? Set an Exam Date and we'll automatically adjust your daily pace!
onboarding.habit_description: Consistency is your ultimate superpower. Clear your tailored 'Daily Stack' in just a few minutes. Add our Home Screen Widget and turn on notifications so you never miss a review.
onboarding.try_it_description: Don't just take our word for it. Upload a document, Paste a Web link or type a topic you want to learn about right now, and watch the magic happen.
onboarding.result_description: Active recall is the fastest way to learn. Read the question, guess the answer, then tap to flip. Swipe Right if it was easy, or Left if you need to review it again soon. Try it!
onboarding.result_card_q: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
onboarding.paywall_description: You've just seen how fast studying can be. Go Premium to unlock unlimited AI generations, unlimited daily reviews, and advanced document uploads. Invest in your brain today!
